reasoning: Tome XII is a multi-work collection; no complete English translation exists. De Circuli Magnitudine Inventa (its major treatise) appears in English in Pi: A Source Book (Berggren/Borwein, Springer 2004, appendix), making this a partial prior. All other Tome XII works — Exetasis Cyclometriae, quadrature theorems, tangent constructions, 1652–1656 correspondence — remain untranslated.
